title: Chapter 277: Even the Shadow Is in the Shape of Love
html:
Manager Huang’s unfinished words died in his throat when Chen Ge produced a walkie-talkie from his pocket as if by magic.

“You’re a police officer?!” His reaction came a beat too late.

By the time he realized the situation had spiraled out of control, Chen Ge had already received a reply from Team 1’s leader, Lee Zheng. “Hang in there! We’re coming!”

Hurried footsteps echoed up the stairwell. Team 1 was close!

Manager Huang’s face fell. Victims in his ghost stories had tried calling the police before, but they had always needed time to pull out a phone and place the call. Chen Ge, however, had produced a walkie-talkie from his breast pocket without warning. Worse, nothing about him had suggested that he was a police officer!

Resentment, fear, and screams were a Baleful Specter’s favorite food. Manager Huang had been forced to commit cruel, terrifying acts to keep the monster possessing him from devouring him. Yet the man before him had raised three Baleful Specters of his own, including the most terrifying kind—a Red Specter. By the Ghost Stories Society’s standards, this man must have claimed at least ten lives!

And yet this bloodstained butcher worked with the police?!

Furious, Manager Huang knew tonight’s disaster could not be easily contained. Even if he killed Chen Ge, he would have to abandon his current identity. “This is all because of you!”

Matters of the shadows were supposed to be settled by the rules of the shadows. None of them had expected a ‘traitor’ in their midst!

The blood face reacted even more violently than Manager Huang. The visage woven from blood hurtled toward Chen Ge, its features shifting until they resembled his.

This thing again.Chen Ge swung the walkie-talkie at the blood face, but the device passed straight through it. He could not even touch his enemy.

“If I kill you—or even seize control of your body for a moment—I may still escape.” Only Chen Ge knew Manager Huang’s true identity. If the blood face possessed him and silenced him permanently, Manager Huang would still have a chance to get away.

Just before the blood face reached him, Chen Ge’s pupils narrowed into catlike slits, radiating a bone-chilling force.

“Yin Yang Vision!” It stopped the blood face for only half a second, but that was all Chen Ge needed. He kicked off the floor and launched himself forward in a reckless charge.

He slammed into Manager Huang, sending them both tumbling down the stairs. Scratches opened along his arms, and pain shot through his body. To his surprise, however, it vanished almost at once.

When his vision cleared, Chen Ge rose to flee down the stairs—only to discover black hair wrapped around every joint in his body.

Zhang Ya?Apart from a few superficial bruises, Chen Ge was completely unharmed.

Manager Huang was not so fortunate. The black hair slowly dragged him back up the stairs.

The blood face had been pierced through, and Manager Huang lay unconscious, his body twisted at unnatural angles as the hair hauled him upward.

Chen Ge turned and looked up the stairwell from the twenty-second floor. Zhang Ya stood silently on the twenty-third, dressed in red. The waterfall of black hair behind her bound the conjoined twins, the blood face, and the thin monster, forming a dark river that flooded the corridor.

Her dress shone as bright as fresh blood, while black hair pooled around her feet. The hideous monsters screamed and groaned as they were torn apart and devoured. Even Chen Ge felt a surge of panic at the sight.

Zhang Ya descended toward him, bringing with her a bone-deep chill and the thick reek of blood. Something about her had changed again. It seemed she had obtained what she wanted.

She raised her bowed head, and her black hair parted like curtains. Her face stopped mere centimeters from the tip of Chen Ge’s nose. She stared into his eyes, a plain wooden box resting in her pale, lifeless hands.

“For me?” The moment Chen Ge spoke, a cold draft rushed into his body. He accepted the wooden box and opened it. The stain of black blood had vanished, replaced by a grotesque doll.

“The man with the ruined face!” The doll was a tenth of the man’s original size. His mask was gone, and apart from his eyes, every feature had been ground flat. He had neither nose nor lips, like a demon plucked from a nightmare.

“You turned him into a toy?!” The doll was the man’s soul, ripped from his physical body. Its terrifying face twisted from side to side, radiating a malignant presence.

When Zhang Ya had dealt with her own killer, she had also extracted Zhu Xiu’s soul and made it into a toy.

The sight of the man struggling inside the box made Chen Ge’s hair stand on end. This was the second most terrifying gift he had ever received; first place unquestionably belonged to Zhang Ya’s love letter.

“Thank you. I… really like it. You’re the first girl ever to give me a present.”

At his words, Zhang Ya looked away. She lowered her head as if unwilling to let him see her expression, but Chen Ge could sense her happiness.

The black hair never stopped moving. Even as they held this ‘friendly conversation’ on the twenty-second floor, it continued devouring the monsters on the twenty-third.

As the black hair slowly withdrew toward Zhang Ya, Chen Ge spotted Xu Yin’s broken body and his mouth fell open. “Wait! The young man screaming in pain and the girl in the school uniform are my friends. Please don’t hurt them!”

The pleasant atmosphere vanished. When Zhang Ya raised her head again, she had returned to her usual self. Xu Yin and the Pen Spirit were expelled from the river of hair, which then coiled in on itself, crushing the remaining monsters and bathing the corridor in fresh blood.

Zhang Ya’s body swayed as though drowsiness had overtaken her. She looked up at Chen Ge, then walked past him. By the time he turned around, she had disappeared.

The chill behind his back remained. Chen Ge felt a pair of resentful eyes following his every move. It was only two minutes later, when Lee Zheng’s voice rose from downstairs, that the sensation finally faded.

Chen Ge’s body had gone rigid with cold. He collapsed onto the floor, recalled the badly injured Xu Yin and Pen Spirit, and shoved the strange box into his pocket.

Each of Zhang Ya’s gifts was more terrifying than the last. First came a candy made from a human soul; now, a ‘toy’ fashioned from a deranged murderer.

Chen Ge looked back with a bitter smile. In the faint glow of his phone, he discovered something horrifying—his shadow no longer resembled him!

The weak light fell across his body, but the shadow it cast belonged to a long-haired woman.

Chen Ge changed his tune without hesitation. “But these gifts are priceless! No girl has ever treated me so well! I’ll remember this feeling for the rest of my life!”
